review_rationale: Restore the original Wayfatours host-pinned first-enrollment UUID compatibility as a separate strictly scoped entry into the existing, nonauthorizing Site Profile save-current-site flow. No caller-supplied UUID is authority. A new, unambiguous tenant must match fixed, independently host-owned UUID, exact canonical origin, explicit WordPress environment, and nonempty host company code; an already present valid profile always fails rather than changing existing identity. An alternative reserved UUID continues to require the original delegated external attestation filter and cannot be combined with host-pinned input. Host-pinned preflight issues no grant, OAuth credentials, Site Profile mutation, publication or live execution; existing Site Profile CAS/pending-audit and feature gates stay unchanged. Fail-closed PHP 7.4/8.5 positive and negative hermetic tests plus original Site Profile 1825 assertion lifecycle matrix are required. Neither Host constants by themselves nor a Draft PR certify authority; actual provisioning, deployed Origin proof, signed Host and production rollback remain separate.
